French Toast Roll-ups

French Toast with an exciting rolled-up twist.

15 minPreparation
10 minCooking
4Servings

Ingredients

For 4 servings

Let’s make it.

  1. Trim the crusts from each slice of bread and flatten it with a rolling pin.
  2. Spread with 1 or 2 teaspoons cream cheese and Kissan Mixed Fruit Jam. Roll the bread up tightly.
  3. In a shallow bowl, whisk the eggs and milk until well combined.
  4. In a separate shallow bowl, mix the sugar with the cinnamon.
  5. Heat a non-stick pan on medium heat and melt a tablespoon of butter.
  6. Dip each bread roll in the egg mixture to coat it well and place in the pan seam side down. Cook a few at a time until golden brown, turning to cook and brown on all sides, about 2 minutes per side. Add butter to the pan as needed.
  7. Remove cooked rolls from the pan and immediately roll in the cinnamon sugar until completely covered. Serve at once.
